lines.t: Hear and have understanding, open your hearts today,
The power of God is revealed through the Son, The Truth, The Life, The Way.
He is in Me and I in Him, forever we are one,
All creation sings His name, the glory of The Son.
For through Him all things were made,
And by His word we stand.
In Him, all things consist — His touch is in every land.
Oh beloved, lift your voice, let every heart believe,
For His love restores the earth, His Spirit never leaves.
No eye has seen, no ear has heard, no mind can comprehend,
The wonders He’s prepared for those who love Him.
Before we call, He answers; before we speak, He hears,
The fountain of His mercy flows beyond all years.
For through Him all things were made,
And by His word we stand.
In Him, all things consist — His touch is in every land.
Oh beloved, lift your voice, let every heart believe,
For His love restores the earth, His Spirit never leaves.
From the dawn of time He reigns,
All creation bears His name.
Through the storm His light remains,
Forever and the same.
For through Him all things were made,
And by His word we stand.
In Him, all things consist — His touch is in every land.
Oh beloved, lift your voice, let every heart believe,
For His love restores the earth, His Spirit never leaves.
Hear and have understanding, the mystery is undone,
The Father and the Son are one — forever, they are one.
